mapper.update: UPDATE classroom_sessions SET poll_data = JSON_SET( poll_data, CONCAT('$.options[', #{optionIndex, jdbcType=INTEGER}, '].count'), COALESCE( JSON_EXTRACT(poll_data, CONCAT('$.options[', #{optionIndex, jdbcType=INTEGER}, '].count')), 0 ) + 1, '$.totalVotes', COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(poll_data, '$.totalVotes'), 0) + 1 ) WHERE id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
